localFacts.fact: CBS: Dutch men aged 19 were on average 182,9 cm tall in 2020, women 169,3 cm. Replaces the CDC US averages in the eye-level section; the Netherlands has the tallest average clients of the three markets.

KLM: hand baggage, including handles and wheels, max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm. The Befree GT XPRO (43 cm), Feisol and MT190XPRO4 (49 cm) and 055 (54 cm) fit lengthwise; the Vanguard VEO 3+ kit (77 cm) does not.
Zoom.nl on indoor portraits: a tripod helps against motion blur at slower shutter speeds, and between frames you can adjust the lighting or add a reflector while the composition stays the same.

Dutch terms: balhoofd / kogelkop (ball head), middenkolom, snelkoppelingsplaat; zakelijke portretfoto or profielfoto are the common words for a headshot; Arca-Swiss keeps its name. Dutch shops list 'maximale hoogte met middenkolom'.

localPainPoints.pain: Unsure whether a tripod strapped to the backpack is allowed as hand baggage when flying to a location shoot.
localPainPoints.fix: A tripod that folds to 43-54 cm fits inside a KLM cabin bag (55 x 35 x 25 cm); the Vanguard kit (77 cm) goes in the hold. Check with the airline before flying.

quotes.text: Weet iemand toevallig of ik dat ding gewoon aan m'n rugzak gebonden als handbagage mee kan nemen?

localPainPoints.pain: Security or airline staff can refuse a tripod in the cabin on one leg of the trip.
localPainPoints.fix: Keep the tripod inside the bag, not strapped outside, or check it in; the Befree is the pick for travel days (post: 'Offices, conferences and travel').

quotes.text: Heb met Ryanair gevlogen, de heenweg was geen probleem, de terugweg absoluut wel! Moest het ruim in dus.

localGain.point: Eye-level targets for Dutch averages (CBS), with 17 cm head and camera on top: men 182,9 cm -> eye level about 170 to 173 cm -> legs of about 153 to 156 cm; no pick reaches that on its legs (the Vanguard, 148 cm, comes closest), so Dutch studios need the column or a posing stool. Women 169,3 cm -> eye level about 156 to 159 cm -> legs of about 139 to 142 cm; the Vanguard (148 cm) and Befree (142 cm) reach it, the Feisol and 055 (140 cm) come within a couple of cm, the MT190XPRO4 (135 cm) falls about 4 to 7 cm short.
Location headshots by plane: KLM's 55 cm cabin-bag length takes the Befree (43 cm), Feisol and MT190XPRO4 (49 cm) and 055 (54 cm), not the Vanguard kit (77 cm).
Zoom.nl's indoor portrait tip: a tripod keeps the composition while you change the light or add a reflector, which supports the 055's Easy Link arm and the Vanguard's MA1 multi-mount picks.
Maker metric figures instead of conversions, including Vanguard's 148 cm / 174 cm / 77 cm and Feisol Europe's 140 cm / 174 cm.
